title: Empty TypeError message with bad column selection

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

labels.name: Error Reporting
labels.description: Incorrect or improved errors from pandas

body:
I was trying to guess, in a dataframe with multi-indexed columns, how to select all columns with a given second-level value.

And then I hit an empty `TypeError` message

```
In [8]: df = pd.DataFrame(columns=['i', 'c', 'x', 'y'], data=[[0, 0, 1, 2], [1, 0, 3, 4], [0, 1, 1, 2], [1, 1, 3, 4]])
```
